newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA LOOKS TO FOREIGN-BASED PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA LOOKS TO FOREIGN-BASED PLAYERS.

text.p: Romania coach Anghel Iordanescu named 14 overseas-based players in a 20-man squad on Friday for World Cup qualifiers against Liechtenstein and Lithuania.
Midfielder Gheorghe Popescu, currently with Barcelona, will miss both games because of injury.
Undefeated Romania leads group eight with nine points from three matches. They play Liechtenstein on March 29 in Bucharest and Lithuania away on April 2.
Goalkeepers - Bogdan Stelea (Steaua Bucharest), Florin Prunea (Dinamo Bucharest), Dumitru Stangaciu (Vanspor, Turkey)

Defenders - Dan Petrescu (Chelsea), Daniel Prodan (Atletico Madrid), Anton Dobos (AEK Athens), Liviu Ciobotariu (National Bucharest), Marius Baciu (Steaua Bucharest), Tibor Selymes (Anderlecht), Cosmin Contra (Dinamo Bucharest)

Midfielders - Gheorghe Hagi (Galatasaray, Turkey), Costel Galca (Mallorca, Spain), Denis Serban (Steaua Bucharest), Iulian Filipescu (Galatasaray), Dorinel Munteanu (Cologne), Ionut Lupescu (Borusssia Moenchengladbach)
Forwards - Viorel Moldovan (Grasshoppers Zurich), Ion Vladoiu (Cologne), Adrian Ilie (Galatasaray), Gheorghe Craioveanu (San Sebastian).
